text:
maria: Quick sprint: finalize landing copy for Hosted / Dedicated / Private + webinar gating and lead routing. Two-week runway?
aj: Yep. Aim webinar Wed 10am PT, pre-launch post 48h before.
noah: I'll do three hero options in Figma by Fri (engineering, value, compliance).
sam: I'll draft one comparison stat and short benchmark blurbs for each mode (p95, cost signal).
tess: I will build webinar page + HubSpot form. Routing: hidden `mode` field -> hosted=inbound, dedicated=ae, private=ae+se. Example form snippet: `<input type="hidden" name="mode" value="dedicated">`.
maria: UTMs: utm_campaign=tri_mode_launch_v4, utm_content=hero_variant. Gate `latency_playbook.pdf` behind reg. Default hero = Hosted if no mode.
aj: CTA families for A/B (14 days): A) "Get started" / "Reserve capacity" / "Request consult"; B) "Try hosted now" / "Talk to sales" / "Book private demo". Experiment key `tri_cta_v3`.
sam: Benchmark blurb draft: "Dedicated shows tighter p95 under sustained load; Hosted scales quickly for burst; Private adds audit/KMS controls. See playbook for numbers."
noah: Hero shortlines (draft): Hosted: "Hosted API — fast to ship." Dedicated: "Dedicated capacity — predictable latency." Private: "Private deployment — enterprise controls."
tess: I'll add hidden utm_source and utm_medium to form links and map HubSpot tags accordingly.
ops-bot: Reminder: deploy window Tue 18:00 PT. Put assets in /releases/marketing by Mon 16:00 PT.
maria: Action items: noah Figma (Fri), sam benchmark CSV + playbook (Thu), tess landing + workflow (Mon), aj social + post (Mon). Quick dry-run Mon EOD. Thanks! :rocket:
